title: The holiday plugin no longer shows language identifiers, making it hard to distinguish between otherwise identically-named entries
line: The Holidays settings page now shows the language of each region in countries with several holiday files, like Belgium (French, Dutch, Walloon).
explanation: kholidays ships one holiday file per language for countries like Belgium, Bangladesh or Serbia, all with the same name and often the same description. The Holidays page only showed name and description, so these appeared as identical rows. The page's helper now counts files per country code and, for countries with more than one, returns the file's language name (KLanguageName, localized to the UI language, with a QLocale fallback); the page shows it at the start of the subtitle.

commits.message:
plasmacalendarintegration: show the language of holiday regions

Countries with one holiday file per language, like Belgium or Bangladesh,
were listed as several identical rows in the Holidays settings page. The
language name is now shown in the subtitle of those regions.

BUG: 482125

media.caption: Holidays page searching 'Belgium' on master: three identical 'Belgium' rows
With the fix: Belgium rows show French, Dutch and Walloon
Searching 'Bangladesh' on master: two identical rows 'Holiday file for Bangladesh'
With the fix: 'Bengali · Holiday file for Bangladesh' and 'US English · Holiday file for Bangladesh'

review.text: The screenshots show that adding the language makes the identical rows distinguishable. But the list comes from KHolidays' own HolidayRegionsModel, which exposes only region, name and description, and the fix works around that with a plasma-workspace helper that re-enumerates all region codes, counts files per country and pulls in KF6::ConfigWidgets for KLanguageName. Per the brief, the missing data belongs in kholidays.
changes: In kholidays' src/declarative/holidayregionsmodel.cpp, add a language role (the localized language name of HolidayRegion::languageCode, perhaps only for countries with more than one file, or a flag saying so).
In HolidaysConfig.qml, show that role in the subtitle, and drop the qmlhelper languageName()/m_filesPerCountry code and the new KF6::ConfigWidgets/KF6::Holidays links.
